name: Onboard a new hire (first week)
tagline: Welcome email → Slack intro → wait one day → manager checks in on day 1.
description: Three-phase task for the first week of a new hire's experience. Phase 1 fires the welcome workflow (drafts an email + Slack intro). Phase 2 waits a day for human review. Phase 3 reminds the manager to do a 1:1 check-in on day 1.

phases.name: Day 1 check-in reminder
phases.human_instructions: Today is the new hire's first day. Do a 1:1 check-in. Approve when done — that closes out this task.
